projection_theorem.continuous_normal_law: Only original continuous ideal Z0,Z1 are independent standard normals. Native shared finite pair is never assumed independent. L has mean mu=ln100-1/800 and variance v=3/400.

projection_theorem.exact_tilt_mass: exp(2mu+2v)=10000*exp(1/80)<=10000*80/79, using exp(x)<=1/(1-x) for 0<=x<1; analytic inequality only, no series evaluated.
projection_theorem.exactly_two_own_profile_bounds: Evaluate this rational formula once using primary90 original inputs and once using independent130 own original inputs; do not select a minimum, require nesting, mix adapters, or return a third candidate.
projection_theorem.native_exponential_allowance_unevaluated: A=alpha*M+beta from original full-clipped-domain absolute envelope |S_N-exp(L_N)|<=alpha*exp(L_N)+beta; original clip inactive at site
projection_theorem.pointwise_three_term_proof: |S_N-exp(L)|<=A+M*|L_N-L|+|exp(P(L))-exp(L)|; square with pointwise Cauchy for three terms, then take expectation.
projection_theorem.projection: P(x)=min(max(x,a),b), a=raw_lower/Q, b=raw_upper/Q; mathematical comparison only, no source/policy change
projection_theorem.upper_projection_tail_pointwise: On L>b, 0<=exp(L)-exp(b)<=exp(L); upper squared-tail contribution <=E exp(2L)1{L>b}.
